Oracle Workforce Shrinks by 21,000 Employees Amid Growing AI Use

Oracle cuts 21,000 jobs as AI adoption reshapes operations, with more workforce reductions possible in the future. Oracle revealed that AI-driven operational changes contributed to a workforce reduction of around 21,000 employees over the past year.
